risks.proof: A video clip of a cold start and the engine idling.

risks.risk: Transmission may have slipping or broken gears.
risks.proof: A video of the bike being ridden through all gears.

risks.risk: Ownership documents may not match the license plate or may be expired.

proof_requests: Video of the engine starting from cold and idling.
Video of the motorcycle being ridden to demonstrate gear shifts and braking.
Clear photo of the registration papers and proof of ownership.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Suzuki AX100 (or a common clone like Muonek). Several seller claims regarding age and originality are contradicted by the photos, so it is priced as a well-used, non-running unit.
